threats.name: Passive network observation
threats.description: Observation of network traffic without modification.

threats.name: Active network control
threats.description: Observation and active manipulation of network traffic on controlled paths.

threats.name: Service data access
threats.description: Read access to information available to service infrastructure.

threats.name: Malicious service control
threats.description: Ability to make service infrastructure deviate arbitrarily from prescribed behavior.

threats.name: Account-control compromise
threats.description: Unauthorized account-level authentication or authorization capability.

threats.name: Credential theft
threats.description: Unauthorized acquisition of authentication or authorization artifacts.
capabilities: use stolen recovery codes where accepted

threats.name: Endpoint secret-state compromise
threats.description: Snapshot compromise of endpoint cryptographic secret state without assumed continuing control.
capabilities: read endpoint secret state at compromise time
read locally accessible key material at compromise time

threats.name: Live endpoint compromise
threats.description: Continuing execution or observation capability inside the endpoint trust boundary.
capabilities: modify endpoint protocol behavior while control persists

threats.name: Physical device possession
threats.description: Physical possession enabling offline or hardware-assisted attacks against a device.

threats.name: Privileged insider abuse
threats.description: Abuse of legitimate privileged access to service, build, support, recovery, certification, or administrative systems.
capabilities: exercise granted privileged access contrary to policy
target users or systems within privilege scope

threats.name: Malicious software update
threats.description: Delivery of software or configuration accepted as an authorized update.

threats.name: Build or dependency compromise
threats.description: Unauthorized modification of source, dependencies, build inputs, infrastructure, artifacts, repositories, or provenance.

threats.name: Release-signing compromise
threats.description: Unauthorized use of software, firmware, configuration, or artifact signing capability.
capabilities: authorize malicious releases within key scope

threats.name: Recovery-system compromise
threats.description: Unauthorized capability over recovery secrets, recovery services, trustees, authorization, or recovery hardware.
capabilities: attempt identity or data recovery beyond authorization

threats.name: Backup compromise
threats.description: Acquisition of retained backup material and associated service-side information.
capabilities: attempt offline attacks using acquired material

threats.name: Secure-hardware compromise
threats.description: Violation of security assumptions of an HSM, TEE, secure enclave, TPM, token, or related protected hardware.
capabilities: extract or misuse hardware-protected secrets within compromised scope
subvert hardware-enforced policy within compromised scope

threats.name: Directory equivocation
threats.description: Presentation of inconsistent identity, key, device, membership, or directory views to honest participants.

threats.name: Metadata observation or inference
threats.description: Observation or inference of communication and relationship metadata.
capabilities: correlate timing, sizes, identities, devices, relationships, and access patterns

threats.name: Availability attack
threats.description: Selective or broad denial, suppression, flooding, or exhaustion of communication or service.

threats.name: State rollback or replay
threats.description: Restoration, replay, fork, or presentation of stale cryptographic or policy state.

threats.name: Randomness failure
threats.description: Prediction, bias, disclosure, or adversarial influence over cryptographic randomness.

threats.name: Time-source manipulation
threats.description: Manipulation of time inputs used for security-relevant validity or freshness decisions.
capabilities: induce stale or premature time decisions

threats.name: Store-now-decrypt-later quantum adversary
threats.description: Recording of present ciphertext for later cryptanalysis with future quantum capability.
capabilities: record ciphertext and protocol data now
apply future cryptographically relevant quantum computation

threats.name: Active quantum adversary
threats.description: Active protocol adversary with cryptographically relevant quantum capability.
capabilities: combine quantum cryptanalysis with active network capabilities

composite_scenarios.name: Malicious service plus active network
composite_scenarios.description: Service-side deviation combined with manipulation of network traffic.

composite_scenarios.name: Account compromise and device enrollment
composite_scenarios.description: Compromised account authority is used to add or substitute device/key state.

composite_scenarios.name: Temporary endpoint state compromise
composite_scenarios.description: Endpoint secret state is exposed and later communication proceeds in the presence of an active network adversary.

composite_scenarios.name: Live endpoint compromise and later recovery
composite_scenarios.description: An adversary controls an endpoint and may attempt to preserve or restore compromised state after control is removed.

composite_scenarios.name: Backup plus credential compromise
composite_scenarios.description: Stored backup material is combined with stolen authentication or recovery credentials.

composite_scenarios.name: Recovery plus account compromise
composite_scenarios.description: Account authority and recovery mechanisms are simultaneously compromised.

composite_scenarios.name: Malicious update with service targeting
composite_scenarios.description: A malicious service selectively targets a user with endpoint code accepted as an authorized update.

composite_scenarios.name: Supply-chain plus signing compromise
composite_scenarios.description: Build or artifact compromise is combined with authority to sign malicious output.

composite_scenarios.name: Directory equivocation with selective service behavior
composite_scenarios.description: The service forks identity or membership views and targets participants selectively.

composite_scenarios.name: Physical possession with credential attack
composite_scenarios.description: Possession of a device is combined with attacks against credentials or locally accessible authorization material.

composite_scenarios.name: Harvest now, decrypt later
composite_scenarios.description: Traffic is recorded now for later cryptanalysis using future quantum capability.
